description: This file defines the Aws\Sts\StsClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Security Token Service (STS). It includes methods for various STS operations, constructor logic for regional endpoint configuration, and credentials creation logic.

classes.name: Aws\Sts\StsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Security Token Service (STS), providing methods for temporary credentials and identity management with support for regional endpoints configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the STS client with regional endpoint options and other configurations.

methods.name: createCredentials
methods.description: Creates Credentials objects from the result of an STS operation, extracting necessary fields and handling different user types.

methods.name: addBuiltIns
methods.description: Adds service-specific built-in options for endpoint configuration based on provided arguments.
